name: Grade 3
theme: The Commandments and the Beatitudes: living as God’s children

units.title: God’s plan of love
units.eq: How does God show his love?

lessons.title: God speaks to us
lessons.idea: God reveals himself through creation, his word and his Son. The Bible is his word written by humans.
lessons.question: How does God speak to us today?
lessons.activity: Investigate the Bible’s parts: Old and New Testament. Locate Genesis and Matthew.
teach: Revelation means “unveiling”: God shows himself. Three ways: creation, Scripture and, above all, his Son (Hebrews 1:1-2).
Avoid saying God only speaks in the Bible; the Church also hands on his word in Tradition.
Let children list ways they learn about a friend (words, actions, time together) and compare with how we learn about God.
talk: How do you get to know a friend?
Where do you see God’s work in creation?
Which part of the Bible have you heard?
quiz: God reveals himself most fully in…|A dream|His Son, Jesus|A rock|A book only|1|Hebrews 1:1-2.
The Bible is God’s word in…|Secret code|Human words|Songs only|Pictures|1|CCC 105-106.
Revelation means…|A mystery story|A test|God showing himself|A secret|2|CCC 50-53.
lessons.life: Read one Gospel story with a parent this week and ask: “What does this show me about God?”
lessons.saint: Jerome: he spent his life translating the Bible so people could know Christ.

lessons.title: The Bible: our holy book
lessons.idea: The Bible has 73 books. The Old Testament tells of God’s promises. The New Testament tells of Jesus.
lessons.question: How many books are in the Bible?
lessons.activity: Create a “Bible shelf” with labeled sections.
teach: Use a map of the Bible’s sections: Law, History, Wisdom, Prophets, Gospels, Acts, Letters, Revelation.
The Catholic Bible has 73 books: 46 in the Old Testament, 27 in the New.
Teach children how to find a verse: book, chapter, verse.
talk: Which Bible story do you like?
Why is the New Testament about Jesus?
quiz: The Bible has…|73 books|100 books|27 books|10 books|0|CCC 120.
The Gospels tell about…|David|Moses|Jesus|Noah|2|CCC 124.
The Old Testament came…|After Christ|At Pentecost|Before Christ|In the 1900s|2|CCC 121.
lessons.life: Find your favorite Bible verse and write it on a card.
lessons.saint: Jerome: patron of Bible scholars.

lessons.title: Covenant: God’s promise
lessons.idea: A covenant is a special promise. God made covenants with Noah, Abraham, Moses and David. Jesus makes the new covenant.
lessons.question: Which covenant is your favorite?
lessons.activity: Make a timeline of five covenants with symbols.
teach: A covenant is a sacred family bond. Show how God’s covenants grow: Noah (all creation), Abraham (a family), Moses (a nation), David (a kingdom), Jesus (all people).
Use a ladder or timeline.
Tie to Mass: Jesus says “the new covenant in my blood.”
talk: What promise did God make to Abraham?
What is new about the new covenant?
quiz: A covenant is…|A sacred promise-bond|A contract for money|A wish|A rule|0|CCC 56-57.
The new covenant is made in…|A city|Jesus’s blood|A temple|Moses’s law|1|Luke 22:20.
God’s covenants show that he…|Is angry|Forgets|Is far|Keeps his promises|3|CCC 62.
lessons.life: Keep one promise you made, even if it is hard.
lessons.saint: Abraham: our father in faith.

units.title: The Ten Commandments
units.eq: How do we love God and others?

lessons.title: Loving God
lessons.idea: The first three commandments show how to love God: he comes first, speak his name with respect, keep Sunday holy.
lessons.question: What can take God’s place in our lives?
lessons.activity: Sort cards of things we love (family, sports, phone, God) from least to most important, then discuss why God comes first.
teach: Walk through commandments 1–3 with examples. Have children name modern “idols” (screens, money, popularity).
God’s name is holy: avoid misuse and use it in prayer.
Sunday: rest, Mass, family time.
talk: What can take God’s place in our hearts?
How do we keep Sunday special?
When do we say God’s name with respect?
quiz: The first commandment says…|God first|Self first|Friends first|Money first|0|CCC 2083.
To keep the Lord’s day holy, we…|Work|Go to Mass and rest|Play only|Shop|1|CCC 2177.
God’s name should be…|Honored|Joked about|Hidden|Forgotten|0|CCC 2142.
lessons.life: Plan a screen-free hour on Sunday with your family.
lessons.saint: Thomas More: he put God first.

lessons.title: Loving our neighbor
lessons.idea: The last seven commandments teach us to honor family, respect life, be faithful, honest and generous.
lessons.question: Which commandment helps most at school?
lessons.activity: Role-play scenarios and choose which commandment applies.
teach: Commandments 4–10 teach love of neighbor. Cluster them: family (4), life (5), faithfulness (6, 9), property (7, 10), truth (8).
Use case cards: choose which commandment applies.
Make the connection to the two greatest commandments.
quiz: Commandments 4–10 teach love of…|Self only|Neighbor|Animals|God only|1|CCC 2196.
Do not steal means…|Run|Respect others’ things|Hide|Eat|1|CCC 2401.
Honor your father and mother includes…|Laziness|Silence|Fear|Respect and obedience|3|CCC 2214.
lessons.life: Choose one commandment to focus on this week.
lessons.saint: Louis and Zélie Martin: they lived the fourth commandment in their family.

lessons.title: Following with a good conscience
lessons.idea: We use our conscience to follow God’s law. We learn it, pray and ask advice.
lessons.question: How can you form a good conscience?
lessons.activity: Create a “decision tree” for tough situations.
teach: Conscience is a judgment of reason. It must be formed by the Church, Scripture and prayer.
Use decision trees: stop, think, pray, ask, act.
Distinguish scruples from a well-formed conscience.
talk: How do you know when something is wrong?
Who helps you form your conscience?
What do you do when you’re unsure?
quiz: Conscience is…|A rule|A judgment of reason about right and wrong|A feeling|A habit|1|CCC 1778.
We form conscience by…|Following friends|Prayer, learning and advice|Ignoring it|Guessing|1|CCC 1785.
We should always follow…|Whim|Peers|Fear|A well-formed conscience|3|CCC 1790.
lessons.life: When in doubt this week, ask a parent or teacher before deciding.
lessons.saint: Thomas Aquinas: he taught that conscience binds.

lessons.title: The Beatitudes
lessons.idea: Jesus gives eight paths to blessing. They show a life of trust and love.
lessons.question: Which Beatitude is most surprising?
lessons.activity: Illustrate each Beatitude in a classroom book.
teach: The Beatitudes are Jesus’s portrait of himself and of disciples. Read them slowly.
Pair each with a concrete action.
Link to the saints.
quiz: The Beatitudes are from…|Genesis|Acts|The Sermon on the Mount|Revelation|2|Matthew 5.
Blessed are the…|Poor in spirit|Famous|Rich|Strong|0|Matthew 5:3.
The Beatitudes point to…|Wealth|True happiness|Fame|Power|1|CCC 1721.
lessons.life: Do something for “the meek” or “the peacemakers” this week.
lessons.saint: Francis of Assisi: he lived the Beatitudes.

lessons.title: Faith, hope and love
lessons.idea: The theological virtues are gifts from God. They help us believe, trust and love.
lessons.question: How can we grow in virtue?
lessons.activity: Make a virtue tree. Add leaves for each act.
teach: Faith, hope, love are gifts given at Baptism. We grow them by use.
Provide examples: faith in a promise, hope in hardship, love in service.
Teach 1 Corinthians 13:13.
talk: How can you love a difficult person?
quiz: The three theological virtues are…|Joy, peace, patience|Courage, fairness, wisdom|Prayer, fasting, almsgiving|Faith, hope, love|3|CCC 1812.
The greatest is…|Faith|Courage|Hope|Love|3|1 Corinthians 13:13.
Virtues are…|Rules|Good habits|Games|Gifts only|1|CCC 1803.
lessons.life: Practice one virtue each day: faith on Monday, hope on Tuesday, love on Wednesday.
lessons.saint: Thérèse: the little way of love.

lessons.title: Courage, fairness, wisdom, self-control
lessons.idea: The cardinal virtues are habits of living well. They help us choose good.
lessons.question: What helps you control your temper?
lessons.activity: Role-play situations that call for each virtue.
teach: Cardinal virtues: prudence (right choices), justice (giving what is due), fortitude (courage), temperance (self-control).
Use simple examples.
Let children rank which they need.
talk: How do you control your temper?
quiz: Prudence is…|Being quiet|Being strong|Choosing well|Being fair|2|CCC 1806.
Justice gives…|Candy|Chores|Rest|What is due|3|CCC 1807.
Temperance helps with…|Self-control|Reading|Running|Singing|0|CCC 1809.
lessons.life: Practice temperance by waiting patiently in line.
lessons.saint: Joan of Arc: courage.

units.title: Jesus the Savior
units.eq: Who is Jesus and what did he do?

lessons.title: Jesus is true God and true man
lessons.idea: The Son of God became man. He lived among us and he saves us.
lessons.question: What shows that Jesus is human? That he is God?
lessons.activity: Use two-column notes: signs of Jesus’ humanity and divinity.
teach: Present both truths: Jesus is fully God and fully man.
Use a two-column chart.
Mention the Creed.
quiz: Jesus is…|Only man|Only God|True God and true man|An angel|2|CCC 464.
The Incarnation means…|God became man|A story|A trick|Man became God|0|CCC 461.
Jesus got…|Tired and hungry|Never tired|Lost|Sick of God|0|CCC 470.
lessons.life: Pray, “Jesus, true God and true man, have mercy on me.”
lessons.saint: Athanasius: he defended the truth about Jesus.

lessons.title: Jesus teaches and heals
lessons.idea: Jesus announces the kingdom with words and miracles.
lessons.question: Why did Jesus do miracles?
lessons.activity: Study one miracle story and create a comic strip.
teach: Select a miracle story. Ask what it shows about Jesus.
Use a comic strip.
Distinguish signs from magic.
talk: How do miracles help us believe?
quiz: Miracles are…|Tricks|Signs of God’s power|Magic|Accidents|1|CCC 547.
Jesus calmed…|A storm|A road|A house|A tree|0|Mark 4:39.
He raised…|Lazarus|A king|A coin|A tree|0|John 11.
lessons.life: Thank God for a “small miracle” each day.
lessons.saint: Padre Pio: signs and healings.

lessons.title: Cross and Resurrection
lessons.idea: Jesus died for our sins and rose on the third day. He opened heaven to us.
lessons.question: Why is Easter the biggest feast?
lessons.activity: Create a simple Holy Week timeline.
teach: Holy Week outline: Palm Sunday, Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Easter.
Emphasize love and sacrifice.
Handle suffering with sensitivity.
quiz: Jesus died on…|A bed|A hill of stone|A boat|The cross|3|CCC 613.
On the third day he…|Left|Stayed dead|Hid|Rose|3|CCC 638.
The Resurrection shows…|It was a story|Jesus conquered death|He was tricked|It was a dream|1|CCC 654.
lessons.life: Make a cross from two sticks and place it in your home.
lessons.saint: Mary Magdalene: witness of the Resurrection.

units.title: The Holy Spirit and the Church
units.eq: What does the Holy Spirit do?

lessons.title: Pentecost
lessons.idea: At Pentecost the Holy Spirit came on the apostles. The Church began her mission.
lessons.question: What changed for the apostles?
lessons.activity: Dramatize Acts 2:1-13. Tell it in a news report style.
teach: Pentecost: wind, fire, many languages. The Church is born.
The Spirit gives courage and gifts.
Link to Confirmation.
quiz: Pentecost took place…|On Good Friday|In Lent|At Christmas|Fifty days after Easter|3|CCC 731.
The apostles spoke…|Only Hebrew|Many languages|Only Latin|Nothing|1|Acts 2:4.
The Spirit is…|An angel|A saint|A ghost|God|3|CCC 685.
lessons.life: Pray a Veni Creator or “Come, Holy Spirit” each morning.
lessons.saint: Peter: he preached at Pentecost.

lessons.title: The Church is one, holy, catholic, apostolic
lessons.idea: These four marks help us recognize the Church Jesus founded.
lessons.question: What do these four words mean?
lessons.activity: Make a poster of the four marks with symbols.
teach: The four marks: one, holy, catholic, apostolic. Give a simple example of each.
Use a church picture.
Explain that these come from Christ.
quiz: “Catholic” means…|Old|Universal|Local|Roman|1|CCC 830.
Apostolic means…|Local|Ancient|Large|Founded on the apostles|3|CCC 857.
The Church is holy because…|The building is old|Christ is holy|The priest is good|People are perfect|1|CCC 823.
lessons.life: Say the marks at Mass and think what each means.
lessons.saint: Peter and Paul: apostles.

lessons.title: Pope, bishops, priests and laypeople
lessons.idea: Everyone in the Church has a part. We all share in Jesus’ mission.
lessons.question: Who are the leaders in your diocese?
lessons.activity: Interview a parish staff member; make a “parts of the body” chart.
teach: Map the Church’s roles: Pope, bishops, priests, deacons, laity.
Interview a parish worker.
Everyone has a part.
quiz: The Pope is…|A king|A prophet|An emperor|Successor of Peter|3|CCC 882.
The laity are…|Baptized members who are not ordained|Bishops|Priests|Deacons|0|CCC 897.
Deacons serve in…|Charity and the word|Teaching only|Voting|Business|0|CCC 1570.
lessons.life: Say a prayer for your pastor.
lessons.saint: John XXIII: a joyful pope.

lessons.title: Mary, Mother of God
lessons.idea: Mary is the Mother of God and our mother. She lived by faith.
lessons.question: What does Mary teach us about faith?
lessons.activity: Pray a decade of the Rosary with simple reflections.
teach: Mary’s faith: she heard, trusted and acted.
Pray one decade of the Rosary.
Mary points to Jesus.
talk: How do we pray the Hail Mary?
quiz: Mary is the Mother of…|God|Peter|Joseph|The apostles|0|CCC 495.
At Cana Mary said, “Do…”|Run|Nothing|Stay|Whatever he tells you|3|John 2:5.
The Hail Mary comes from…|A movie|Scripture and the Church|A game|A school|1|Luke 1.
lessons.life: Pray a decade of the Rosary.
lessons.saint: Bernadette: she prayed the Rosary.

lessons.title: The communion of saints
lessons.idea: All God’s people are united: on earth, in purgatory and in heaven.
lessons.question: Who prays for you?
lessons.activity: Make a “litany” of saints with names from your parish.
teach: The Church on earth, in purgatory, in heaven: one family.
Use a litany.
Pray for the dead.
quiz: The communion of saints includes…|All God’s holy people|Only monks|Only living|Only canonized|0|CCC 946.
Purgatory is…|A hotel|A place of despair|A cleansing|A prison|2|CCC 1030.
Saints pray…|Never|Against us|For us|Only for angels|2|CCC 956.
lessons.life: Write a litany with names of saints and family members.
lessons.saint: All Saints: November 1.

lessons.title: Heaven and eternal life
lessons.idea: We are made for heaven. Our choices lead us toward God or away.
lessons.question: What does it mean to choose God?
lessons.activity: Write letters to God thanking him for life and eternity.
teach: Heaven, hell, purgatory with care for the youngest.
Heaven is life with God. Our choices matter.
Be hopeful.
talk: What does it mean to choose God?
What do you hope for in heaven?
How can you help others get there?
quiz: Heaven is…|Rest only|Life with God|A cloud|A place of toys|1|CCC 1024.
Our choices…|Are forced|Don’t matter|Matter|Are random|2|CCC 1033.
God wants all to be…|Famous|Rich|Saved|Lost|2|1 Timothy 2:4.
lessons.life: Make a thank-you card to someone who helped you.
lessons.saint: Dismas: the good thief.

units.title: The sacraments
units.eq: How do the sacraments help us?

lessons.title: What is a sacrament?
lessons.idea: Sacraments are signs Jesus gave to give us God’s life. There are seven.
lessons.question: Name the seven sacraments.
lessons.activity: Match each sacrament with its sign and effect.
teach: A sacrament is an effective sign. Show matter, form.
Match each sacrament with its sign.
Mention that Christ instituted them.
quiz: A sacrament is…|A story|An outward sign that gives grace|A party|A ritual only|1|CCC 1131.
Baptism uses…|Bread|Incense|Water|Oil|2|CCC 1214.
The seven sacraments were instituted by…|Saints|Christ|Bishops|The Pope|1|CCC 1114.
lessons.life: List the seven sacraments from memory.
lessons.saint: Thomas Aquinas: explained the sacraments.

lessons.title: Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist
lessons.idea: These three sacraments of initiation bring us into the Church.
lessons.question: What do the three have in common?
lessons.activity: Show each with props: water, oil, bread.
teach: Initiation: Baptism, Confirmation, Eucharist. They form one journey.
Use props: water, oil, bread.
Explain order and purpose.
talk: What do they have in common?
quiz: Confirmation uses…|Chrism oil|Salt|Bread|Water|0|CCC 1293.
The Eucharist is…|Source and summit|A symbol|A treat|Optional|0|CCC 1324.
Baptism is the…|Door|Floor|Window|Roof|0|CCC 1213.
lessons.life: Look at photos of your baptism and thank God.
lessons.saint: Pope St John Paul II: he often reminded the young of their baptism.

lessons.title: Reconciliation, Anointing, Orders, Matrimony
lessons.idea: Healing and service sacraments help us in need and in mission.
lessons.question: How does each sacrament help the Church?
lessons.activity: Interview a priest or deacon about his work.
teach: Healing: Reconciliation and Anointing. Service: Holy Orders and Matrimony.
Interview a priest or deacon.
Explain vocation.
talk: How do these help the Church?
quiz: Anointing of the Sick helps…|Priests|The seriously ill|Teachers|Healthy people|1|CCC 1499.
Holy Orders makes…|Teachers|Bishops, priests, deacons|Kings|Doctors|1|CCC 1536.
Matrimony is…|A lifelong covenant|A short promise|A party|A game|0|CCC 1601.
lessons.life: Pray for priests and married couples.
lessons.saint: Louis and Zélie Martin: a married couple saint.

lessons.title: Why we pray
lessons.idea: Prayer is raising our hearts to God. We pray because God invites us.
lessons.question: When is it easy to pray?
lessons.activity: Create a prayer routine.
teach: Prayer is a conversation. Practice ACTS: adoration, contrition, thanksgiving, supplication.
Create a daily prayer plan.
Keep it simple.
quiz: Prayer is…|Raising the mind and heart to God|A trick|A chore|A speech|0|CCC 2559.
God hears…|Only the loud|Only the long|Only the good|Every prayer|3|Psalm 34.
To pray we need…|Fancy words|An open heart|A special place|A priest|1|CCC 2562.
lessons.life: Set a prayer time and keep it for a week.
lessons.saint: Teresa of Avila: she called prayer friendship.

lessons.title: Kinds of prayer
lessons.idea: We adore, praise, thank, ask and say sorry. Prayer can be vocal, meditation or contemplative.
lessons.question: What kind of prayer do you pray most?
lessons.activity: Sort prayers by type; compose your own.
teach: Sort prayers into types (adore, thank, ask, sorry).
Write a prayer for each.
Share.
quiz: Adoration says…|God is great|Please|Sorry|Thank you|0|CCC 2628.
Intercession is…|Singing|Praying for ourselves|Not praying|Praying for others|3|CCC 2634.
Thanksgiving says…|Please|Thank you|Hello|Sorry|1|CCC 2637.
lessons.life: Pray for someone by name every day.
lessons.saint: Monica: she prayed for her son Augustine.

lessons.title: The Rosary
lessons.idea: The Rosary helps us pray with Mary and remember Jesus’ life.
lessons.question: Which mystery speaks to you?
lessons.activity: Pray the Rosary with a sensory aid; make a simple rosary.
teach: The Rosary: five mysteries in four sets. Use a visual guide.
Pray a decade slowly.
Link each mystery to Scripture.
talk: What do you think about while praying?
quiz: The Rosary meditates on…|A map|A recipe|The life of Jesus and Mary|A race|2|CCC 2708.
There are…|Four sets of mysteries|Ten sets|Two sets|One set|0|Rosarium Virginis Mariae.
The Rosary begins with…|The Gloria|The Hail Mary|The Sign of the Cross|The Amen|2|Tradition.
lessons.life: Pray one decade each day this week.
lessons.saint: Dominic: Rosary devotion.

units.title: The Church year and Sunday
units.eq: How do we live the Church year?

lessons.title: Sunday and the Mass
lessons.idea: Sunday is the Lord’s Day. We go to Mass and rest.
lessons.question: Why is Sunday special?
lessons.activity: Plan a “Sunday rest” checklist for family.
teach: Sunday: the Lord’s Day. Rest, Mass, family.
Plan Sunday rest.
Explain Mass obligation.
talk: How does your family spend Sunday?
quiz: Sunday is…|A secret|The Lord’s Day|Saturday|A work day|1|CCC 2174.
We rest to…|Grow tired|Honor God|Hide|Sleep|1|CCC 2184.
Catholics must go to Mass on…|Sundays and holy days|Never|Fridays|Mondays|0|CCC 2180.
lessons.life: Keep one hour of Sunday free from screens.
lessons.saint: Pope St John Paul II: Dies Domini.

lessons.title: Seasons and colors
lessons.idea: The Church year has seasons that tell Jesus’ story with colors.
lessons.question: What are the colors of the seasons?
lessons.activity: Create a liturgical calendar.
teach: The church year and its colors. Create a calendar.
Match seasons and colors.
Link to scriptural events.
quiz: Advent is…|Red|White|Purple|Green|2|Liturgy.
Easter is…|Purple|Red|Black|White|3|Liturgy.
Pentecost is…|Green|Purple|Red|Black|2|Liturgy.
lessons.life: Mark the church year on your family calendar.
lessons.saint: Pope Gregory I: shaped the liturgy.

lessons.title: Holy days and the saints’ feasts
lessons.idea: Special feasts honor Mary and the saints. They teach us how to follow Christ.
lessons.question: Which feasts does your parish celebrate?
lessons.activity: Plan a feast day celebration.
teach: Holy days: Immaculate Conception, Assumption, All Saints, Christmas. Explain each.
Plan a feast.
Link to saints.
quiz: Dec 8 is…|All Saints|Immaculate Conception|Christmas|Easter|1|Liturgy.
Aug 15 is…|Assumption|Pentecost|Epiphany|Ascension|0|Liturgy.
Nov 1 is…|Easter|All Saints|All Souls|Christmas|1|Liturgy.
lessons.life: Celebrate a feast day with a special meal and prayer.
lessons.saint: Mary: honored on many feasts.
